paraphrase: The Kṣurikā ('razor') teaches a concentration (dhāraṇā) by which the mind, joined with breath, cuts through the vital points of the body from the feet upward and all the channels except the suṣumnā; with the razor of mind sharpened on the stone of dispassion the yogin severs the bonds of rebirth. Recorded as a summary only; no steps.
